find_python_files: recursively find all Python files in a given directory and return their paths
check_datetime_fromtimestamp_with_utc: check if datetime.fromtimestamp calls in a Python file use tz=timezone.utc via AST analysis
test_datetime_fromtimestamp_calls: run a pytest parametrized test that validates all Python files use tz=timezone.utc in fromtimestamp calls
review_datetime_fromtimestamp_usage: review a Python codebase to find datetime.fromtimestamp calls missing the tz=timezone.utc argument
summarize_python_file_discovery: summarize how to recursively discover all Python files in a directory tree using os.walk
